note: Stage-2 serial GPU queue. Start via the TianchiStage2Queue scheduled task (run_stage2_task.bat), which survives the DSH app closing. Order matters: R3' creates the baseline every later arm is compared against. Add arms only after their PREREG.md exists.

arms.name: r3prime_mosaic1280_s42
arms.notes: R3': retrain the mosaic1280 baseline from scratch (60 ep, ~15-16 h at workers=4). Replaces handoff R3, which cannot run because the original best.pt is unavailable. Its official mean becomes the new B*.

arms.name: r3pp_uniform_s42
arms.notes: R3'': the 5-epoch uniform fine-tune control (mosaic1280 best.pt start, lr0 1e-4, amp OFF, mosaic 0). Becomes the control value for every fine-tune arm (A1/D1/M1/S4), replacing the unreproducible 0.6158 / crit_recall 0.6260.
